source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Dialect Class
tts_text: Professor Lin was a specialist in the dialect of the eastern hills, and his lecture on the first Monday of term was a special event. The course was not compulsory: students could opt for it or select another. Forty came, and half of them were optimistic, half pessimistic. "I have one specific aim," he said. Then he read the specification aloud: three hundred words that exist nowhere else. "The speciality of these hills is a word for the sound of rain on stone," he said. Every case was particular, every rule unique, and his handwriting was a little peculiar, even weird. A girl in the front row was bothered by one habit of his. He would stop in the middle of a sentence and look at the ceiling. It did annoy her, and she could not ignore it. But Professor Lin only smiled. "Do not neglect the pause," he said. "The pause is where the old people put their feeling." Then he asked the class to collect one word from home. He supplied boxes and one small supplement, a recorder. He told each student to embrace the work slowly, and not to be negative or passive. "You will be acquainted with a world you have never heard," he said. "Thirty years from now, this dialect will be gone." "So choose now." "Elect one word to carry with you."

sentences_cn: 林教授是东部山区方言的专家，开学第一个周一的讲座是件特别的事。
这门课不是必修的：学生可以选它，也可以选别的。
来了四十个人，一半乐观，一半悲观。
“我只有一个很具体的目标，”他说。
然后他把课程说明念了出来：三百个别处不存在的词。
“这片山区的特产，是形容雨打石头那个声音的词，”他说。
每个案例都很个别，每条规则都独一无二，他的字也有点古怪，甚至可以说奇怪。
前排的一个女生被他一个习惯弄得心烦。
他会在句子中间停下来，抬头看天花板。
这确实让她恼火，可她没法不理它。
但林教授只是笑了笑。
“别忽视那个停顿，”他说。
“停顿，是老人家放感情的地方。”
接着他让全班每人从家里收集一个词。
他提供了纸箱，还有一份小小的补充品——一台录音机。
他让每个学生慢慢地拥抱这项工作，不要消极，也不要被动。
“你们会认识一个从没听过的世界，”他说。
“三十年后，这种方言就没了。”
“所以现在就选。”
“选一个词，带在身上。”
